svg.title: DIVYANSHU — I write the part that checks the model's work.
svg.desc: Parity gates for COBOL ports, interlocks for ER discharges, frame-cited defect reports for substations, and sealed incidents for liquid-cooled racks. FOCUS: Verification · safety interlocks · accessibility. WRITES: Python · TypeScript · Rust. RUNS: Arch Linux · Omarchy.
